name: GigaChat
description: Sber's GigaChat gives individuals 365 million free tokens a year, renewed annually.
overview: GigaChat is Sber's Russian-language model family, served through developers.sber.ru with an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at api.giga.chat. Individuals get a freemium quota of 365,000,000 tokens valid for twelve months and renewed yearly: 250M on Lite, 50M on GigaChat 3 Ultra, 40M on Pro and 25M on Max. Authorisation is via Sber ID rather than an API key alone, and the free quota is licensed for personal, non-commercial use. That is the largest published free allowance on this index, and it is measured per individual rather than per organisation.

privacy.label: Stored in Russia, personal non-commercial use

free_access: 365M tokens per year, split 250M Lite / 50M Ultra / 40M Pro / 25M Max
No card and no prepayment for the individual freemium quota
Personal, non-commercial use only under the beta terms
notes: Russian-language strength; the console and docs are Russian-first. Quotas are per model family and renew every twelve months. Commercial use requires a paid agreement.
